subject: E-Commerce
title: Loss Aversion in Shopping
description: A quick, practical guide to Loss Aversion in Shopping.

hook.text: Humans feel losses 2x more than gains. E-commerce exploits this: 'Only 2 left!' triggers panic buying.

buildup.text: Scarcity signals activate loss aversion. Limited stock warnings make items feel more valuable than they are.

discovery.text: Booking.com shows '3 people looking at this right now.' The fear of losing out drives faster decisions.

twist.text: Many scarcity signals are fake. Investigations found that some 'limited stock' counts reset every hour.

climax.text: Loss aversion is the most powerful psychological lever in e-commerce. Fear of missing beats desire for having.

punchline.text: Fear of losing beats desire for having. 'Only 2 left' works every single time.

quiz.question: Why does 'Only 2 left in stock' make people buy faster?
options: Loss aversion makes the fear of missing out stronger than wanting it
